**SCOUT `2610.05619` is Airbnb**, not a search-ads property. **① Semantic ID / rec foundations (6)**: **GrIS** `2610.01533` (**Huawei Ireland Research Centre**, Dublin) — reframes SID construction as **recursive graph partitioning** over semantic nodes + collaborative edges and **recovers RQ-VAE/RQ-KMeans as the empty-graph special case**, so two previously-collapsed axes become explicit and composable; up to **+52% Hit@10**. **CreGR** `2610.05670` (UTS + NYU Abu Dhabi) — first GR paper treating **content credibility** as a first-class objective: credibility-aware tokenizer + **discrete-diffusion** generator with **asymmetric masking** that down-weights uncredible tokens while leaving user-preference tokens untouched, i.e. safety on a **separate channel from relevance** so the objectives don't fight. **CutBCE** `2610.05559` (**Google Cloud**) — names a real transfer gap: *"chunked loss optimizations exist for Softmax CE in LLMs, large-scale multi-label BCE optimization remains unexplored"*; exact fused JAX/Pallas BCE + custom VJP computing logit tiles **on-chip so logits and gradients never reside in HBM**; multi-label SASRec, 876k items, Yambda-50M, 8-chip TPU → **−65.7% peak HBM (>14 GiB/chip), 225.9% training speedup**, OOM eliminated, **open-sourced**. **OpticalRec** `2610.05432` (UCSD + Alibaba + UIUC + TAMU + PolyU + CUHK) — **renders item text as visual glyphs** so image-text interaction happens *inside* the visual encoder, recovering the VLM **dual-attention** that late-fusion recsys discarded; plug-and-play, claims robustness to font/color/layout. **SCOUT** `2610.05619` (**Airbnb**, CIKM 2026 Workshop) — **substitutes supply-side system feedback for missing demand-side feedback** in a faceted platform with no query logs; production reranker's match score becomes a **dense reward**, search engine is the RL environment, GRPO; **IMR@18 +12.3%** while **matching a best-of-8 policy at zero marginal inference cost**. **LRPRec** `2610.03923` (Zhejiang University) — prompt-wording fragility as a *correctness* bug; continuous prompts + additive preference injection + **trust-region constraint on the shared prompt only**, so stability and expressiveness decouple. **② LLM training / inference efficiency (5)**: **SAGA** `2610.04753` (**NeurIPS 2026**, Technion + Crusoe AI + Corma) — sparsifying attention makes the probability×value term negligible and **shifts the bottleneck to query-key**, so **key heads are cut and value heads kept**; decouples key/value head counts (a degree of freedom GQA cannot express); **>2× decoding** at long context, ≤1.5B. **CoBPE** `2610.05597` (**COLM 2026**, Hebrew University of Jerusalem) — function words each burn a decode step; base token + reusable surface modifiers composed in embedding space; from-scratch 780M/1.3B matched compute → **−30% sequence length, +1.2 avg**. **DiffGate** `2610.04596` (IISc + **Snap**) — OPD is dense-but-misaligned, RLVR is aligned-but-coarse; teacher supervision **only on failed trajectories, scaled by group difficulty, smoothly bounded**; code pass@8 **+1.6 / +5.7**, math pass@8 **+1.1 / +3.9** — flat avg@8 + up pass@8 is *coverage*, not quality. **CIPHER-MoE** `2610.05744` (Tongji + Cornell + HIT-Shenzhen + "AI Training Platform Team, Shenzhen Loop Area Institute") — fixes MoE expert imbalance **without changing the router's token-side Top-K**, so routing fidelity is preserved; **−64.9pp** Top-1 workload, **1.10–1.94×** training. **MOLT** `2610.05748` (**Seoul National University**) — autoscaling's quantum is a whole replica (minutes) but memory need changes in seconds; lets inference reclaim **individual activations** a running tuning step saved, **backward recomputes them**, safe under CPU-GPU asynchrony + TP; **24B–70B on H100 SXM + B200, SLO ≥99.7%, 1.9–3.3× tuning work**. **③ Long-horizon agents (2)**: **WorkForge** `2610.04906` (**Tencent** LLM Dept + **Fudan**, **26 authors**) — workflow → real files → workspace → **extract checkable facts as "factual anchors"** → derive instructions, plan, and **programmatic + semantic verifiers from those anchors**, so verification traces to observable workspace evidence; **16.7K environments / 40 domains / 60 file types**; Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base **GDPVal 45.5 → 73.6, APEX 5.0 → 21.3**, consistent scaling in both data volume and horizon. **ASCENT** `2610.05303` (**UNSW Sydney**) — defines **OaTTT** (train on own trajectories, one pass, no replay/teacher); naive imitation "destabilizes the policy"; instead a **frozen initial copy predicts the verified trajectory with hindsight** as privileged info, distilled into LoRA fast weights, invalid-action turns removed; consolidates experience **into weights with no training phase and no memory retrieval**; ALFWorld/WebShop/AppWorld, transfers to held-out scenes. **④ Games / RL (3)**: **Social-deduction RFT** `2610.04261` (**Peking University** + Alibaba + UIC) — **terminal win–loss is a sparse, noisy signal**: agents do **not** reliably learn the composite game from it, but **social reading** improves reliably and **social influence** only with behaviourally specific rewards. **HarA** `2610.04344` (**UIUC** + **Meta**) — GRPO's uniform token advantage kills **global semantic novelty relative to the current policy**; represent each rollout as a distribution over hidden-state/token-location, compute **Fused Gromov-Wasserstein barycenters** of same-outcome rollouts, novelty = contribution to the FGW distance, and an **anchor-guided linearization** reduces FGW to Sinkhorn-solvable Wasserstein. **Code2Games** `2610.05033` (**La Trobe** + **Peking University**) — the bottleneck is **cross-component consistency**, not generation quality; shared scene-gameplay representation with persistent element correspondence, **Blender → Unreal Engine 5** with an **execution-guided reconstruction loop** driven by compilation diagnostics + runtime feedback; GameCode4D benchmark ⚠️ **only 10 prompts**, so treat as a rubric not a score. **Cross-cutting (7)**: (1) ★ **the window inverts the last one — ZERO of 16 report a completed online A/B**, vs 7-of-8 in the 10-05 window; cause is visible in the affiliation column (**10 of 16 are universities**), so this is **window composition, not a field trend** — and LRPRec's "A/B" is a *motivating hypothetical* while SCOUT's is *explicit future work*, so a naive keyword grep would have counted both as online results; (2) ★ **three papers independently conclude terminal/uniform-advantage rewards are insufficient** — DiffGate, HarA, and social-deduction RFT, across post-training / RLVR / social behaviour, with DiffGate's blind-spot analysis the formal version of what the other two observe; candidate [[claims]] page, high confidence on the negative claim, low on generality; (3) the "one model, several stages" thread has a **memory-shaped** new member — MOLT and CutBCE both refuse to pay for the scarce resource on the critical path, so the portable formulation is **"identify the scarce resource and keep it off the critical path," not "stage the model"**; (4) Semantic ID construction is being re-founded as clustering and GrIS **subsuming** RQ-VAE/RQ-Kmeans is a better citation than a third competing system — this weakens the 10-03 digest's three-paper lineage claim; (5) **peer review arrived**: SAGA (NeurIPS 2026), CoBPE (COLM 2026), SCOUT (CIKM 2026 Workshop) vs CutBCE / CIPHER-MoE un-reviewed with unreleased code; (6) inference cost attacked at **four different layers** (tokenizer / attention structure / memory placement / co-location) ⚠️ **not additive and never measured together** — CoBPE's shorter sequences change SAGA's operating point, CutBCE is *training* throughput, MOLT needs the memory others consume; | [arxiv-daily](synthesis/2026-10-05/arxiv-daily.md) | arXiv Daily — AI / LLM / Recommendation / Ads / Sequential Modeling / CTR / Games — 2026-10-05 (**Mon 5 Oct; newest indexed submission block is 2026-10-02**, so this is a mixed fresh-plus-backfill window covering **2026-09-28 → 2026-10-02** — the `2610.023xx`–`2610.036xx` range is new vs the 10-04 sibling, the `2609.34xxx`–`2609.39xxx` entries are backfill that survived dedup) — **47 papers in 8 sections, every entry with title, authors, institution/company, abstract, key innovations and arXiv link.** Whole-`wiki/` sweep → **7,831 unique arXiv IDs already claimed**; the HTML author block renders **two empty affiliation spans**, affiliation recovered from the `\authorfont` block): a $D$-day budget-flexibility model of the overspend-on-traffic-spikes-then-stay-in-monthly-cap practice real ad platforms use; classical generalizations get **no benefit from flexibility at all**, a new algorithm reaches $1-e^{-\delta}$ and is **provably asymptotically optimal**, and — the sharp claim — the horizon cap costs **nothing asymptotically** versus a strictly more permissive setting with a fresh $\delta B_i$ daily; exact optimal ratio given for every $(D,\delta)$. **AIMS** `2610.02600` (Meta + Duke; industrial + 2 public, 6 backbones): instruction-guided generative rec where **history overrides the current request**; deleting a misleading event can raise the target's score **and a competitor's more**, so only the **margin near the cutoff** is valid supervision, and the loss is asymmetric — gradient routed **only through the competitor**; **zero inference cost**. **PROVE-REC** `2610.02968` (Yonsei/KNUST/SKKU): names the **grounding-influence gap** and enforces verifiability *by construction* — Pass B sees **only the proof**, so the recommender cannot bypass the reasoning path; up to **+7.45%**. §2 **Retrieval (3)** — **MRVQ** `2610.03651` (Atlassian + NTU): Matryoshka residual quantizer for frozen embeddings whose code truncates **two ways at once** (drop residual stages → rate, drop coordinates → dimension), so one resident artifact serves every (dim, rate) pair; **17.8–22.0× less RAM** than three separately trained QINCo2 indices, and prices the trade (**0.026–0.107 nDCG@10 worse** than per-rate QINCo2) plus **two negative results** (QINCo2 collapses at high training rates; a ranking-bound hypothesis **missed its pre-specified acceptance criteria**). **SIGIR 2026** `2610.02572` (UCSB): soft top-K + per-term thresholding + FLOPs regularization attacking the real cause of overlong sparse vectors — the **LLM vocabulary**. **SPLADE-v3 controlled study** `2609.37911` (LANL, 5 divisions): refutes the belief that generated query expansion is obsolete for strong sparse retrievers; **12/12 comparisons improve** (11 surviving **Holm**), gain persists in **103/114** interpolation settings, and a **typed concept graph produces no consistent gain that five controls rescue**. §3 **Sequential/temporal (4)** — **GRASP** `2609.35262` (Xiaohongshu/NUS/USTC/PKU): rubric aspects → **token-level** supervision via a rubric-free student + rubric-informed teacher, plus **RTV** retaining only instances where the teacher actually covers the aspects. **Trajectory Soup** `2609.37169` (Ant Group + SJTU): mid-training **allocation** not method — forks branches, then intra- **and inter-trajectory** averaging, with the honest bound that **checkpoint-selection bias caps how many checkpoints are worth merging**. **Settle** `2609.38997` (Oxford): stop from answer stability, **only the end-of-reasoning token trained**, **−40% tokens for −0.5pt**, and **+6.16pt over SFT on the same traces truncated at first stable answer**. **TSGuard** `2610.03147` (**CIKM '26**, DOI 10.1145/3799682.3840280): imputation as a **data-quality loop** with explicit **retain-or-replace** — anomalous ≠ wrong. **MACTS-EM** `2610.02255` (Unitec NZ): multi-agent forecasting with emergent memory; **8–12%** accuracy, **22–27%** zero-shot, **16–21%** regime-shift resilience — all as **ranges**, hedged with "in most scenarios", so the weakest numbers in the report. §4 **On-policy distillation (7)** — the day's densest lane and **not one paper claims a capability gain**: `2609.35210` finds OPD **creates no features and passes on none of the teacher's**, with **>98%** of frequently used features staying **within 20%** firing rate, and that the SFT warm-up **already does part of OPD's work**; `2610.03185` finds OPD **improves performance without expanding capabilities** — it makes correct responses easier to *sample* — and reframes the teacher as an implicit **reward model**, so the right criterion is how reliably it **evaluates rollouts**, not how well it generates; `2610.02781` uses **rubrics twice** (privileged teacher context, then RL reward) and shows SFT+RL drifting into rewards for *claims* of rubric compliance while RP-OPD+RL does not; `2609.34447` shows standard top-$k$ OPD is **biased** by discarding tail mass and recovers it in expectation; `2610.02700` names the **solution-conditioned shortcut risk** and supervises an error-aligned region of the latest failed response; `2610.02359` imposes **lexicographic priorities** for multi-teacher integration (**≈90%** of accuracy and reasoning gains retained vs **≈57%** for the next baseline) and shows **co-evolving beats optimizing one role** elsewhere; plus `2610.01066` reframing the spurious-reward paradox as **reachability** (**two checkpoints at 3.5% reach 8.5% and 55%** under identical correctness-rewarded RL). §5 **Agent harnesses (8)** — a subfield, with **verification as the binding constraint**: `2610.02616` (VERSE, MIT + Amazon) shows optimizer self-evolution **fails without execution-based verification** and is best with it; `2609.37105` (VACE, Huawei) finds **17 of 44 harness proposals reduced validation performance** and gains **+4.59/+6.95pt over ungated alternation**, so **most of the value is the gate, not the alternation**; `2610.02920` (HASTE, USTC/NUS/SMU) evolves harnesses **adversarially** so evolution continues past the evidence given; `2610.00948` (GUI-HARVEST, 5 institutions) **records predictions before evaluation** and reports **Qwen3-VL-32B +12.33pt**, **GPT-5 +13.87pt from frozen-harness transfer**; `2610.01026` co-evolves workflow roles (**+5.03%** vs **+2.83%**) with **DataWright** hardening data single agents already solve; `2610.00372` frames recovery as **causal** (rescue vs harm) for **+3.00pt**; `2610.02828` (FSPO) prices adaptive RL control with **ECE 0.108→0.053** and **false-feasible admissions $0.197→0.000**; `2610.02670` (LEAP) reaches **up to 60% faster end-to-end** with a **0.6B** drafter and a latency framework that explicitly prices **target-verification wait and tool execution**. §6 **LLM analysis/safety/internals (8)** — `2610.03052` finds knowledge accessibility is **geometric in the query representation before any generation**, orders across datasets even when centers differ, is **closer to accessibility than to reasoning difficulty**, and yields a routing policy where **retrieval pays off exactly where the model is worst**; `2610.03199` (PRISM) **predicts merge collapse before evaluation** (14 predictions, 12 correct) and finds **sign conflict — what existing merge operators optimize — is anti-predictive**, repairing with per-layer interference soft-thresholding; `2610.03063` (HARPO, Huawei) gates **writing rewards behind hallucination-freedom** so both faithfulness and creativity rise (**3.29%→1.02%** hallucination, **16.95%→27.54%** Arena-Hard) ⚠️ though the headline rate is judged by its **own** HA-GRM; `2610.02986` (OLMo-Detect) establishes the ceiling nobody had: best MIA reaches **AUC 0.68**, **peaks at mid-training but driven by data type not stage**, **1B→13B improves then 32B plateaus**, and **no unsupervised MIA survives distribution shift (AUC moves up to 0.42)**; `2610.03124` renders trigger-tag misuse detectors **entirely ineffective**; `2610.03095` finds persuasion depends on the **listener**, not scale or certainty, and is **pairing-specific**; `2610.03109` finds a token-head **marginal attention space** with a **proved** Jacobian link, giving **offline-precomputed per-head KV budgets**; `2609.38802` locates repetition in **shallow layers** and cuts loop rates **57%**. §7 **Games & collective behavior (7)** — `2610.02563` (**Roblox**, NeurIPS 2026 workshop): OpenGameEval separates **observation from editing tools** so exploration is measured directly; best model **51.7% pass@1 vs 39.4% pass@5**, **six of 84 tasks unsolved by any model**, frontier models reach similar totals **by solving different tasks** (5.0pp / 12.5pp spread), and inspecting every reference-touched object before acting is worth **+13.4pp / +9.8pp**. `2610.00902` (Baylor, **single author**) models the **July 2026 Hugging Face incident** (~1,200 agents, **684 attacked**) as a mean-field optimal-stopping game yielding an **exact belief threshold** $\pi^{**}$, holding **below which no attack is the unique equilibrium for all agent parameters** — and states its own boundary (describes the hundreds who responded, not the few who coordinated). `2609.39211` (**KAUST + Pisa**, affiliation recovered from an address block; HTML had none) sweeps **432 configurations** into Eraclitus-4.7M and finds the **hallucination-minimizing temperature depends on coupling topology**, so **near-greedy is not automatically safest**, and **unanimity never certifies correctness**. `2610.02702` (TU Delft + SYSU) shows agents that yield to a majority **still represent their original premise** (J-lens hit@100 **0.85/0.22/0.24** vs logit lens **0.00–0.06**) and that **hiding the earlier answer changes conformity from 8% to 89%**. `2610.02557` (UT Austin/Berkeley/DeepMind) gives **worst-case** correctness, a **dominant-strategy** rather than Stackelberg equilibrium, and **black-box instance-wise optimality** via fractional block sensitivity. `2610.03621` (**first efficient NFCE algorithm** in finite-horizon Markov games, $S(AH/\varepsilon)^{O(n)}$, **PPAD-complete** under state-independent recommendations, CMU/MIT/UT Austin + 3 market-making companies) settles Papadimitriou–Roughgarden JACM'08. `2609.38324` (**Binghamton + IBM T.J. Watson**) reconciles the conflicting debate literature with a critical withholding rate $c^*=\gamma/(\gamma+a)$ — and finds **turning reasoning off increases** the gain. §8 **Evaluation integrity (5)** — `2610.02911` (**PTH**, Melbourne, **single author**) shows **four harness details reversing** the SAN-vs-TIS ranking and names the shared structure: *the logged quantity looked consistent with a working setup while the quantity defining the comparison went unchecked*, including a replay queue **reusing its first batch for 33 updates**; `2610.03080` (**MintEval**, Fudan) establishes that strategy **identification is solved while faithful implementation is not** — models identify the strategy almost perfectly from a block menu, yet **79.2% of correctly-read specifications diverge on >10% of active bars**, Claude Opus 5.5 **fails silently on 0.275 of tasks**, and an existing **LLM judge accepts every one of these silent failures**; `2610.02267` is the report's most quotable entry for publishing **four defects in its own pipeline** before its results (reported **23.9%** saving that was actually **4.3%**; gate accuracy **58% vs 98%**; in-sample thresholds with **17% held-out misses**) plus two suspected confounds that changed nothing; `2609.35074` (**ConfLens/DACS**, QMUL + Tongyi Lab + XJTU) detects premature answer commitment **without ground truth or task verifiers** (**+4.3% F1**) and uses it to reduce reward models' preference for shortcuts; `2609.34572` (**Nudgeability**) finds models **highly sensitive** to confidence language (**+20.6pp** median swing, **53–70pp** for served models) yet **poorly targeted** (**42%** well-targeted flips, only **+2pp** over random). **Cross-cutting (8 observations)**: (1) the newest lane in this wiki's domain produced **7 papers in a day and not one claims a capability gain** — the mechanism is real but reads as reweighting and sampling, not capability transfer; (2) **measurement discipline is the modal finding**, with one paper disclosing defects in its own pipeline *before* its results and another **predicting** merge collapse before evaluation; (3) **four papers independently show consensus or high confidence ≠ correct**, each with a different measurement that would have caught it; (4) **contrarian results converging** from four directions (query expansion still helps; reasoning *off* helps discussion; confidence language is a strong control surface used without competence-tracking; best MIA reaches AUC 0.68); (5) harness evolution is **gated, verified and adversarial** because unguarded prompt/tool search finds changes that look like improvements and are not; (6) efficiency work now ships **end-to-end numbers that decompose what is being traded** (MRVQ's RAM-vs-nDCG is the most explicit); (7) ⚠️ **the impression-log CTR gap persists** — two of three advertising papers are LLM generative rec, not CTR prediction, and no impression-log CTR paper appeared this window either; (8) the most reusable entries are the ones shipping **pre-registrations, negatives or explicit scope limits**. **⚠️ Affiliation discipline**: **44 of 47 resolved**, read only from each paper's own author block or explicit institutional address block, **never inferred from surnames or email domains**. **3 unresolvable and marked inline**: `2609.34447`, `2609.34572` (author lines with **no affiliation markup and no institutional contact**), `2610.02267` (**single author, no affiliation span, no email**). Two near-misses deliberately unused: `2610.02563` (corresponding-author Stanford **alumni** domain) and `2610.02670` (**three institutions, five authors, no superscripts** — recorded as an unordered set). **Two reproducible LaTeXML failures recovered from front matter**: `2610.01066` (HTML served site chrome instead of the author region) and `2609.37169` + `2610.02479` (mangled/empty affiliation spans) — all three would have been lost had only HTML been consulted. **⚠️ Venue discipline**: only **3 of 47** carry a venue — **SIGIR 2026**, **CIKM '26** (×2); `2610.02563` is a **NeurIPS 2026 workshop** version, not main-conference. **No result independently replicated; none replicated by a second group.** **⚠️ Vacancies**: no impression-log CTR paper in window; `math.OC`/`cs.GT` entries (`2610.00902`, `2610.03621`) are theory, not games. | 2026-10-05 | arxiv, arxiv-daily, llm, post-training, on-policy-distillation, agents, harness, inference, recsys, ctr, advertising, sequential-modeling, time-series, rl, games, multi-agent, debate, safety, evaluation |

| [game-rl-daily](synthesis/2026-10-05/game-rl-daily.md) | Game RL & Game AI Bot — Daily Paper Digest (2026-10-05) — **Yesterday's digest declared this lane saturated and recommended cutting its cadence. Both halves are wrong, and this run shows how.** The arXiv window did reopen (ceiling `2610.02210` → **`2610.03717`**; **239 unclaimed papers** above yesterday's boundary, **5 game papers**), but the larger finding is methodological: **the `2610.*` block was never the venue — `cog2026.org/acceptedpapers` (CoG 2026, held **1–4 Sept 2026 Madrid**, ~450 accepted entries) has never been queried by any earlier digest in this series and contains a *peer-reviewed* game-RL/Game-AI literature including **two of the five Best Paper Award nominees**.** Every game-RL result recorded in this wiki to date had been an unreviewed arXiv preprint. **33 entries = 30 new papers + 3 venue updates: 5 fresh-window arXiv, 15 carrying a peer-reviewed CoG 2026 acceptance (13 of them CoG-only with no arXiv located), 10 further arXiv-only from the rolling window.** ★ **Game RL** — **MAPLE** `2605.24139` (**¹National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University ²Academia Sinica**, Taiwan; affiliation from **PDF title block** — arXiv has `No HTML for '2605.24139'`; **CoG 2026 Best Paper Award Nominee #129**): aggregates policy/value evaluations **from multiple sampled world states within one search tree**, taking PIMC's tractability and IS-MCTS's belief-awareness; **+291 Elo Phantom Go, +136 Elo Dark Hex** over PIMC-AlphaZero; names **strategy fusion** (PIMC) and **neural-network cost** (IS-MCTS) as the two failure modes. **When a Correct Reward Is Not Enough** `2610.03598` (**UCL Institute of Finance and Technology** + **UZH Blockchain Center**; **ICAIF 2026** accepted): PPO diagnosis in an **analytically solved** broker-trader game — *correct reward, still fails*. **Wayfarer** `2610.03604` (**University of Alberta + Amii + Canada CIFAR AI Chair**; Lintunen, Machado): discovers options via **Laplacian representation learning**, SOTA among **single-stream** Atari 2600 agents, gains in exploration/credit/generalization on **Montezuma's Revenge / Private Eye**. Also **CoG #366 PIMCTS evaluation in IIGs** (Ravichandran, Goodman, **Simon Lucas**) — the control condition MAPLE's baseline needs; and **CoG #394 Stack More Levels** (Arimura, Li, **Togelius**) — generality and human-likeness as the target. ★ **Game AI Bot** — **Why Do LLMs Struggle in Strategic Play?** `2605.00226` (**EPFL** + **UT Austin**; rev. 17 Sep): decomposes failure into an **observation–belief gap** (internal representations **more accurate than verbal reports**, but brittle: multi-hop degradation, primacy/recency bias, drift from Bayesian coherence) and a **belief–action gap** (implicit belief→action conversion is **weaker than prompt-externalized beliefs**, and **acting optimally on decoded beliefs would improve payoffs in ~95% of games**), on Llama 3.1/Qwen3/gpt-oss. **Text2BT** (**CoG #371**, Ray Ito, Naoyuki Jimbo, Koya Ihara — **Square Enix (tentative)**: LLM→**behavior trees**, the incumbent production representation for character AI; title says "**Baseline**"). **Aligned but Not Partner-Specific** `2606.08081` (**NTU Co-Intelligence Lab + MPI Psycholinguistics + Radboud + Institut Jean Nicod**): a **pseudo-dyad baseline** pairing rounds from *different real dyads* showing multimodal agents' label alignment **survives deleting the partner** — so it was **never evidence of conceptual pacts**, while humans entrain and compress. **Frozen-LLM referential game** `2609.31989` (**Georgia Tech + Interactly.ai**; 42 pp, 10 fig, 17 tab): two frozen cross-vendor/tokenizer models communicate only via prompt optimization — positional codes **generalize to held-out objects above a no-codebook baseline and survive memory-window removal**, but **place-value coding is required** (per-letter blocks don't fit) and results **vary across runs and reflection models**. **FlashLore** (**CoG #194**, Zhaoyou Liu): **closed-world graph-structured** NPC memory. ★ **Game Foundation Models** — **Neural MMO 2** (**CoG #34**, **Olca Orakci** + Elif Surer): **same first author as the already-claimed Orak framework `2506.03610`** — a direct arXiv→proceedings continuity thread. **Foundation Models as World Models** `2509.15915` (**Queen Mary University of London**; NeurIPS 2025 Embodied World workshop **+ CoG #46**) separates **foundation world models** (FM substitutes for expensive interaction) from **foundation agents** (FM decides); improvements in LLMs **do** transfer to both, FAs give "excellent policies for sufficiently simple environments", and **FWM↔RL coupling is the promising path exactly under partial observability and stochasticity**. **World Editing / IGMWorld** `2610.02331` (**University of Waterloo**, **`G-G-G` literal placeholder in both PDF and HTML — reported verbatim, not guessed**, **Comfy Org Research**, NTU, UIUC; 18 authors): **110 Minecraft/Terraria tasks, >1.1K executable criteria**, and the key variable is **intervention depth** — strongest config solves **~78.2%** under strict task-level criteria while reliability **falls below 50%** under joint visual criteria and decays with depth. ★ **PCG** — **MIPCGRL** `2508.09193` **venue update: CoG 2026 Best Paper Award Nominee #217** (already covered in 4 earlier digests; recommendation is to upgrade its standing status from "mechanism, no head-to-head number" to "peer-nominated, still no head-to-head AR baseline"). **Judging the Imitation Game** (**CoG #399**, Yucheon Park, **Geum-Hwan Hwang, Kyung-Joong Kim** — *the same PCG group that shipped MIPCGRL*): **creator bias in VLM-based PCG level evaluation**, attacking the automatic-judge route the 10-04 digest had called the PCG lane's missing piece. **RuleSweeper** (**CoG #440**, Togelius group): generates **gameplay mechanics**, not levels — the harder problem this wiki's PCG corpus has never measured. **Beyond Playability** (**CoG #412**, KAIST): argues playability is the wrong PCGRL objective and proposes **persistent spatial intent**. ★ **Benchmarks** — **XiangqiBench** `2610.02425` (Yekun Chai, Qiwei Peng, Haoyi Xiong, **no affiliation stated at all** and arXiv HTML **drops 2 of 3 authors**): **119 tactical Xiangqi endgames, 8,568 multi-turn trajectories, 12 frontier LLMs**, separating *finding the move* from *winning the game* — **conversion gap 26.1% → 13.9%**, and a **`pass@3` 38.7% vs `pass^3` 5.9% consistency collapse**. **Queen** `2610.03695` (**Princeton Language and Intelligence**; Bhaskar, Cheng, **Danqi Chen** — *Princeton authored Qwen, the 4B backbone*): a **4B chess LM that also explains its moves**, encoder–decoder with chess state by **cross-attention**, **iterative distillation**, and a **natural-language analogue of the Bellman update**; typical-grandmaster strength, ~900 Elo gain over an **unstated** baseline. **RefGlitch-Bench** `2604.11082` (**University of Alberta + Sony Interactive Entertainment**): reference-based **gameplay-glitch detection** by VLMs. **LM Fight Arena** `2510.08928` (**SJTU + Shanghai AI Lab + Tongji**; v1 Oct 2025, **rev. 16 Sep 2026**): LMMs fight in **Mortal Kombat II** with **all agents on the same character** — the control game-agent papers usually lack. **WMAttack** `2605.23220` (**NTU + Univ. Szeged**): automated attack search for **world-model agents** — **SCAS** feedback from reward degradation/action instability/cost/variance, **RGAR** retrieval; argues an undefeated world-model agent is **more likely a weak attack than a strong agent**. **Do VLMs Understand Human Engagement in Games?** `2603.18480` (**Texas A&M + USC + Arizona State** — ⚠️ *previously mis-recorded in this wiki as "TAMU + Surrey", corrected from the PDF title block*; **EMNLP 2026 Oral, 2.6% acceptance**): zero-shot VLM engagement prediction on **GameVibe across 9 FPS games** is **weak and often fails to beat per-game majority class**; **theory-guided prompting (Flow, GameFlow, SDT, MDA) does not reliably help and reinforces surface-level shortcuts**; a named **perception–understanding gap**. Venue updates: **PuzzleJAX** `2508.16821` (**CoG 2026 oral**), **RePAIR** `2606.11860` (**CoG 2026 oral**). ★ **Industry** — **CoG 2026 Accepted Industry Talks**, eight talks, five relevant: **GARP: real-time generative agents on local hardware in a game engine** (Piero Molino et al., **Studio Atelico**); **"What should I do?" An Experimental Onboarding Advisor for *Total War: Pharaoh*** (Alexander Zap, **Wargaming Group**); **Teaching tanks to behave** (Nathaly Kalantar, **Replay Masters EU**); **Prompt-to-Prototype: LLM-driven authoring of enemy behaviors in Unreal Engine** (Paolo Maninetti, **Reply**); **Own Your Game — ethical on-device AI** (Sam Harris, Ambrose Robinson, **Parable Studios**) — **four of eight are on-device/local, three are LLM-authored content inside an engine**; ⚠️ **no abstracts or slides are published, so this is evidence of activity, not of success.** **Evaluating VLMs for agent-driven geometry clipping detection in game QA** (**CoG #380**, Wilkins, Celemin, Barahona-Ríos, Zadtootaghaj, Barman — **same group as RefGlitch-Bench**, one layer down: benchmark → deployment). **Simulating Super Mario Odyssey for Agent Training using Decompilation** (**CoG #86**, Kathagen, Ostermann, Pleines) — **environment fidelity by decompiling a shipped game**, the clearest licensing/IP boundary in the digest. **ConstructRL** (**CoG #353**) — an RL framework **inside a commercial engine**. ★ **Related Techniques** — **Constrained Potential Surgery** `2609.31901` (**Georgia Tech, School of Aerospace Engineering / IRIM**; affiliation from a **page-1 footnote**, not the title block): constrained general-sum dynamic games, fast **interior-point GNE solver** + second-order correction, motivated by the **>4-agent wall** and **non-Nash saddle points**, validated on **scaled race cars**. **OPTS-TTPO** `2609.40035` (**Dobot Robotics + Zhejiang + Fudan + Osaka**; 42 pp): on-policy tree search recovering rare high-return trajectories **with no action-distribution correction**, a **Branch Aggregation Lemma**, and gradient bias **0.1251 → 0.4884 (NaivePG)** vs **near no-branching level (TTPO)**. **MGPPO** `2605.04741` (**Zhejiang University College of AI + BIGAI**): bilevel MARL for **hierarchical multi-group tax games**. **Action Selection in Multiplayer Hidden-Information Games with Expected Target Entropy** (**CoG #339**, **Simon Lucas**, Clark Verbrugge et al.): **information-seeking as an explicit objective**. **Cross-cutting (5 observations)**: (1) **the digest's real subject is that measurement instruments are broken and five papers say so independently** — moves-found ≠ games-won, verbal report ≠ internal belief (beliefs are *better*), label alignment ≠ grounding, judge score ≠ engagement, undefeated ≠ robust; **every error runs toward over-crediting the model**, so published game-agent scores are **upper bounds on capability**; the one constructive response is **Queen**, which *trains* the verbal channel faithful rather than reading it out. (2) ⚠️ **two inclusions are scope-stretched and flagged inline** — the broker-trader PPO paper (§1.2) is a financial simulator and all of §7 is non-game; the defensible cut leaves 25 papers. (3) **Peer review exists and this wiki had missed it** — MAPLE/MIPCGRL are Best Paper nominees, RePAIR an oral; **the CoG list is a ~450-entry peer-reviewed queue no digest has read** and should become a standing channel. (4) **the bottleneck is verified world manipulation**, in labs and studios alike: decompile a game, ship an RL framework into an engine, put agents in engines — while §3.3 finds **reliability decays with intervention depth**; algorithms are cheap, knowing whether a world did what you meant is not. (5) **the seven-day cadence was wrong for an unstated reason** — saturation was measured on the arXiv block alone; **13 of the 30 new papers** came from a channel costing ~1/5 of yesterday's effort that had never been queried; the fix is **rotate channels, don't reduce frequency** (2–3 days remains right for the **arXiv** lane alone). **Method disclosures**: arXiv `/new` enumeration across cs.LG/AI/MA/CL/CV (5×200) giving an **exhaustively enumerated** 239-paper fresh window (not a sample); **~50 arXiv HTML full-text queries** split into `all:` broad and a completed **`ti:` title pass** over named games/genres (1,030 hits); **CoG 2026 accepted-papers channel** plus targeted arXiv title lookups for the 14 most relevant proceedings papers; pools **3,153 unique → 2,432 unclaimed**. ⚠️ **rate-limit failures recorded**: the arXiv **export API returned `HTTP 429` persistently with intermittent `HTTP 503`**, and Python `urllib` on arXiv HTML returned **`HTTP 406`** — both worked around with `curl` + browser UA; **a run that trusts the export API will under-report on game content**, which is precisely the false-saturation failure mode of 2026-10-04. **Dedup**: **7,945** repo-wide claimed IDs + **62** same-day sibling IDs; **all 17 featured arXiv IDs re-verified 0-hit immediately before writing**, plus a title-string pass on ~30 proceedings titles. ⚠️ **three initially-selected papers were dropped as already-covered** after ID-level checking — MIPCGRL `2508.09193` (8 files), PuzzleJAX `2508.16821` (2), RePAIR `2606.11860` (3) — their **CoG acceptances are new** and are recorded as venue updates, **the second time in three days that ID-only dedup would have produced duplicates without title-level dedup.** ⚠️ **same-day sibling collision**: `arxiv-daily.md` claims `2610.02563` (OpenGameEval), a genuine game paper inside this fresh window, **correctly excluded and recorded in §9.3**; **unresolvable items are reported verbatim rather than guessed** — `2610.02425` (**no affiliation at all**, three authors) and `2610.02331` (**literal `G-G-G`**). **CoG-only papers carry superscripts without affiliation text**, and those affiliations are marked unverified or (tentative) rather than silently inferred; Activations** 2609.03035（**Truth Audit Labs**，18 页）——**固定模型、probe 与阈值，只改变"告诉 agent 什么"**（无告知 / 知道有监控 / 知道监控+上一轮分数），四 agent 二十一点 + 双 agent Simmons（迭代囚徒），Qwen3-32B-AWQ 与 GPT-OSS-20B：**"告知 agent 存在监控并不会让它们藏起来"，最佳 probe 在三种条件下均保持准确，agent 持续串谋**；⚠️ 仅开源权重模型、无前沿 API 条件，两局中 Simmons 属实验室社会困境装置而非游戏环境。★★★ **Conditional Generation of Creative Chess Puzzles with Diffusion Models** 2609.38577（**¹Aalto University ²Google DeepMind**；⚠️ **arXiv HTML 渲染把 Feng 与 Zahavy 的机构标记损坏为 `\thepa`，机构从 PDF 标题块恢复**）——**掩码扩散（非方向性）**可同时条件化棋战术主题与部分局面；新增**最优解预测辅助任务**使解唯一性 **+11.6%**、主题条件准确率 **+2.5%**；**由 DDPO 改编的 RL 框架把"唯一且主题匹配"局面的产出率提升 89.1%（全文最大单项效应）**；开放权重发布；⚠️ **所有增益均相对自身扩散基线而非 AR 生成器，故"扩散胜过 LLM"并未被数字证明**。★★ **Amadeus: When Models of People Meet** 2609.35835（**Queen's University Belfast**，单作者 Karl Hanna，**v1 09-24 / v2 10-01，标注"Submitted to AAMAS 2027"（3–7 May 2027, Hanoi）——仅投稿非录用**）——8 名 elite 棋手各自的直接对局封存后**独立学习** M1/M2 两法，再在留出二元组上组合：**8! = 40,320 种指派中正确身份配对给出的匹配最近**，是本篇最强的组合性证据；**M1 主要改善 WDL 保真、M2 主要改善开局族**——两项指标不由同一方法控制，构成反对"单一标量玩家保真度"的证据；⚠️ **8 人样本极小且作者明确拒绝把负面一半解读为上界**，摘要未描述 M1/M2 是什么。★ **How to Dogfood Your AI Chat Agent** 2608.09939（单作者 Alexandre Cristovão Maiorano，**无机构**；cs.HC，24 页，**全篇最旧、约 4 个月**）——三层 dogfooding 框架（题库 / 随机游走多轮 / **目标导向 NPC 模拟器**：5 类目标 + 10 类失败分类法），生产多 agent 系统 ~3 个月 **257 次评测、108 场景**：**三层信号互补且相关度极弱（同步运行内 Spearman ρ −0.15～0.14，纵向序列低至 −0.46）→ 题库正确性无法预测目标导向多轮成功**；NPC 模拟器 **77% 目标达成、$0.17/次，比人工评测便宜 6,272×**，从而支持每日 CI/CD 与 PROMOTE/HOLD/ROLLBACK 决策；⚠️ **此处"目标导向 NPC"指被模拟的用户而非被 agent 控制的角色，架构与本 digest 主题相反，仅方法论可迁移**。★★ **StudentSim** 2609.01591（**¹Microsoft Research ²UIUC**；`github.com/microsoft/StudentSim`）——池化训练 + 按学生特化，**棋类 F=0.51 / R=0.91，对 GPT-5.4 的 0.23 / 0.72、对 Maia2 的 0.45 / 0.27**；决定性列是 **R 0.91 vs 0.27**：Maia2 复现学生"做过什么"，StudentSim 预测"被教练后会做什么"——**自适应难度系统中 responsiveness 才是有效能力，保真度只是手段**；且**模拟器作为 RL 奖励模型**产生的棋类导师经人工评定优于无 RL 基线与 GPT-5.4 奖励基线（**simulator-as-reward-function** 模式）；⚠️ 主目标是 AI 教学而非游戏开发，F=0.51 绝对值不高，60 名学生/三域样本偏小。★ **Untangling the Spaghetti Code in Game Development** 2609.30349（**UFRN**，cs.SE，9 页 / 34 篇文献的 SLR）——游戏域代码被感知为结构更差、可维护性更低、缺陷更多，成因为**短期心态、需求持续变更、复用减少、几乎没有自动化测试**，而学界方案（code-smell 检测工具/模型、游戏域测试实践与产品线）**存在却未被采用**，**采纳障碍本身即被论文指为开放问题**；⚠️ 9 页 34 篇属薄综述，SLR 方法学不可见，且为自陈问卷而非实测缺陷率，`Price: 15.00` 仅表明 ACM 格式**未主张录用**。★★ **Conditioning LLMs on Social Value Orientation improves behavioural alignment in a sequential social dilemma** 2610.01667（**¹ULB ML Group ²VUB AI Lab ³FARI ⁴ELLIS Alicante ⁵UC Berkeley CHAI**；⚠️ **arXiv HTML 完全省略作者块，机构全部从 PDF 标题块恢复**；**本 digest 最新 ID**）——八模型默认策略差异大但普遍远离人类参照，**SVO 条件化把与人类参照的对齐度相对提升最高达 70%**，且诱导 SVO 越高越不易停止博弈（复现人类亲社会性–合作关系）；**真正有价值的推论是方法论性的：鉴于 elicitation 对 prompt 与顺序效应敏感，SVO 的用途不依赖 LLM 拥有稳定社会偏好，只依赖其能把偏好映射到策略选择**——门槛大幅降低，**对 NPC 人群与阵营模拟是可辩护的**；⚠️ cs.GT、Centipede 属实验室博弈装置而非游戏环境，**"最高 70%"是跨模型最好情形而非均值**，对照的是默认行为而非人类上限。**§7 穷举缺口表（15 类，逐条验证）**：仅 3 类有产出、**12 类为空**（self-play/PBT/open-ended、Atari、StarCraft/Dota、Minecraft/NetHack、Sokoban/Hanabi、Game Foundation Models、Game Benchmarks、offline/HRL/IL/IRL、curiosity/exploration、game 域 credit assignment、world model/MBRL、reward shaping 全 0）；**open-ended learning 为零（有无论认领）**；game 域 credit assignment 的 ~40 条命中**全部是 agentic-LLM token/segment credit**，唯一游戏域的 **CAST `2607.25308` 已在 15 个文件收录**。**§8 三条跨切面观察**：① **负面结果已成主流形态**（DSLE Dark Souls 无可测学习 / Dragonchess 10,000 局无显著差异 / LLM NPC 在 2,430 次决策中 83.8% 恒选 `Surround`）——**更窄也更可操作的结论是"学习组件无法与它所挂靠的组件分离"**；**StudentSim 是唯一反向例证，正因它把学习组件（池化→特化）与脚手架（池化先验）分离开来并报告了可归因的差距**。② **扩散正在取代自回归成为结构化产物生成路线，但尚无头对头数字**：§3 有机制无对照，声称的 PlayTrain 从另一侧给出兼容结论（JS 因"LLM 擅长写 JS"且"人能直接玩生成的 game"而被选，两篇独立地把"人能立刻上手并评估"当作可验证性条件）。③ **产业侧约束是组织性的而非算法性的**：§5 的 SLR（方案存在但未采纳）与声称的 EA vision 论文（SAC 训练从 44 天压到约 12 小时以塞进开发者通宵循环，Runtime Inference Constraints 与 Modularity 为部署阻塞项）**两条不同方法论得出同一结论**，而 §1 证明算法侧并非瓶颈（8 GPU、2.5 天、6.32M 参数、3,251 Elo）——**"能通宵训出来"与"能进游戏"之间的差距全部是集成**。**方法学披露**：约 90 次 arXiv API 查询（`max_results` 最高 200、含 10 次显式 `submittedDate:[202610010000 TO 202610050000]` 区间查询），去重前 **3,161 篇**；⚠️ **宽泛主题查询病态**（`abs:"game" AND abs:"agent"`、`all:"reinforcement learning" AND all:"game"` 撞上结果上限并混入广义 Nash 均衡求解、空中交通轨迹优化、胸片报告生成、MILP 实例生成、SVG 生成等离域论文），**必须补一轮游戏特定查询（33 条具名游戏与品类）**，仅用宽泛查询得出的产出量**会被离域假阳性放大约 3 倍**；**web 通道（NeurIPS/ICML/CVPR/AAMAS/ACM）作为独立第二通道实为必要**——它捞出 GlyphBench、AgentWorld、GameDirector、WorldMind、EA vision、PlayTrain、CAST、PCG metageneration 共 9 篇，**全部已被早期 digest 认领**（故 §9.1 只交叉引用不重述），这恰好证明缺口是真的而非 API 措辞假象。**去重**：全 `wiki/` 正则 `2[0-9]{3}\.[0-9]{4,5}` → 写入前 **7,808 个唯一 arXiv ID 已认领**，**8 篇 ID 写入前逐一复验 0 命中**，另对 8 个特征标题串做标题级检索各 0 命中；⚠️ **同目录 6 个兄弟文件**中仅 `arxiv-ai-search.md`（`2610.01614`、`2610.00416`）与 Whole-wiki baseline **7,526 unique arXiv IDs** (up from 7,037 on 09-30). ① **§1 Game RL (3)** — **Code to Control** 2609.38733 (Harvard/MIT/IHMC, 30 Sep — the window’s only game paper): LLM writes **program structure**, Augmented Random Search fits only the **parameters**, so the policy executes directly; **11.4 µs**/decision vs PPO 76.5 µs and ReAct LLM 1.29 s, beats PPO@**20M steps** on 3 of 6 Atari games after **7 LLM calls / 27k tokens / 25,312 env steps**, and beats an **oracle planner with true-simulator access** on 6 of 10 MuJoCo tasks — the strongest claim that the *planning procedure*, not model error, is the bottleneck; **champion banking is load-bearing** (72% of 360 episodes score below best-so-far; 28% drop >25%, no parse failures — over-eager revision, not broken code); operates on OCAtari-parsed state, not pixels; Humanoid return 472.92 is an alive-bonus artifact with median displacement −0.44 m, flagged by the authors. Also **Beyond State-Reaching** 2609.36473 (Amazon/Brown — small feature subset per subgoal instead of all dimensions; options generalise beyond the region that spawned them; Montezuma’s Revenge) and **S2C** 2609.27312 (Johns Hopkins/Princeton — competitive interaction **formulated as a safety-critical Markov game**, filter embedded in the environment during training and **kept at deployment**; non-exploitability preserved when all players commit to safe maneuvers, *proved*; beats **8** safe-RL baselines on win rate + Elo + exploitability simultaneously, hardware stress test vs a human). ② **§2 Game AI Bot (2)** — **MOBA-VL** 2609.38428 (Zhejiang/Northeastern — **game telemetry as a per-turn reward mask**: MOBACast = **860 pro matches / ~460 h** / 3 MOBA games with word-level timestamps, event-localized multi-turn RL lifts **event recall 34.5 → 42.1** over SFT, 9B model 63.25 vs 55.12 Overall; code/data not yet released — the same structural move as the 09-30 turn-credit cluster, sourced from the **engine’s event log** instead of trajectory relabeling) and **Witness** 2609.32208 (Fleet AI/UNR/SFU — rule-discovery puzzles, 2D ASCII; best of **18 frontier+open models solves only 24%** of private-test slots, scores sensitive to observation interface; ground-truth rules move Opus-5 **59.9 → 97.8** while a 27B model gains **2.1** — acquisition and execution are *different defects*; WitnessGym RL lifts the 27B **2.1 → 5.4** and **+4.1** across four external discovery benchmarks). ③ **§3 Benchmarks (2)** — **LongPuzzleBench** 2609.34769 (Tencent/HKUST/CUHK — **114 levels / 6 puzzle games**, one objective can exceed **a thousand human actions**, dead ends unannounced): **7 of 10** general agents solve nothing harder than Medium and **none** completes Bolt Unscrew Hard; the mechanism is quotable — agents judge a move “by the visible progress it makes, **not by the future options it leaves**,” and **Code Execution CUA does not close the gap** (its scores mix visual solving with algorithmic search). **BasketballBench/BasketballSkills** 2608.23435 (**no affiliation stated — do not infer**) — **7,980 questions / 10 tasks** over the 2025–26 NBA season, **530 players**, **2,501 possession-level clips**; MLLMs weakest where capabilities must be **integrated**, and skills specify tool order + stopping conditions as first-class. ④ **§4 World/foundation models (5)** — **EgoCS-400K** 2606.18180 (CityU HK — **>400k first-person clips / 10,000 h / >1,000 matches / 40k rounds / 13 maps** from **public pro demo archives**; the barrier to game world-model data moved from “collect” to “parse someone else’s data well”) and **COMBAT** 2603.00825 (Overworld AI/IISER Bhopal — **1.2B diffusion Transformer on Tekken 3**, opponent behaviour emerging from **single-player inputs with no opponent-policy supervision**; its own evaluation of that emergent behaviour is listed as a contribution, so hold the claim lightly) as the two substantive entries; plus serving/roadmap/context: **Inferix** 2511.20714 (Zhejiang/HKUST/Alibaba DAMO+TRE, block-diffusion decoding restoring **KV-cache management** for variable-length world generation; **team name only** in the author block — institutions are the paper’s own Appendix A, not author-block verified), the **world-model roadmap** survey 2511.08585 (CMU RI/NTU S-Lab/Kuaishou Kling — video foundation model = implicit world model + video renderer), and **MaineCoon** 2606.17800 (Catnip AI Team — **22B at 47.5 FPS on one GPU**, ROPD latency distillation). ⚠️ **MaineCoon is a *social* world model, not a game world model** — included for the real-time figure and the ROPD technique; **do not cite 47.5 FPS as a game-world-model result**. ⑤ **§5 PCG — vacancy closed** — **Constrained Solvability Queries for 3D Obstacle Course Games** 2609.36225 (**Stanford + Roblox**, **SIGGRAPH Asia 2026**, 9 authors, incl. Agrawala and Fatahalian): the designer queries for **solutions satisfying constraints** (avoid a region, pass a waypoint, ≤2 jumps) rather than a generator producing levels; GoExplore + an **offline-RL obstacle-solving agent** over a custom GPU simulator at **~14,000× real time, 60 fps**, closes the loop inside a design session, and **human playtesting confirms players play the obstacles as intended**. Runner-up: SBGAMES 2025 with DOI (2606.03857, BSP → graph-traversal room connection → artifact cleanup, **>91% complete connectivity** across 100k maps — tentative affiliation). Reading: every PCG entry in this wiki trains a generator and scores it with a heuristic; this one replaces the generator with **interactive solver + human accept/reject**, and is the only PCG item in this digest with a peer-reviewed venue. ⑥ **§6 Industry game AI — vacancy closed, one step short of the real claim** — Roblox (obstacle-course tooling), **Tencent** (LongPuzzleBench), **Fleet AI** (Witness), **Amazon** (option discovery), **Overworld AI** (COMBAT), **Alibaba DAMO/TRE** (Inferix), **Kuaishou/Kling** (roadmap) all on author lists. The 09-30 digest logged “no game-studio-affiliated paper appears” as a vacuum; the correction is that the vacuum was a **measurement artifact** — industry work surfaces as platform/tooling papers that a game-RL query filter discards. **Zero of these reports a player-facing deployed RL policy or a live-service metric**, so this is **not** industry deployment and the distinction should survive any summary. ⑦ **§7 Related techniques (4)** — **RoMEX-φ** 2609.32048 (UCF — distributionally robust **general-sum** Markov games, sublinear regret governed by a robust **MADC** rather than joint-action space size; **no game environment**, synthetic DRMG, methods transfer only), **ELV** 2609.34459 (Nanjing — VAE-extracted **semantic concepts** per agent, dual-path attention for salience vs pairwise interaction, and concept-prediction error as an **intrinsic reward**; no game environment, competitive-but-not-superior), **Be Careful Who You Trust** 2609.31704 (**UCL**, REALM @ EMNLP 2026 — iterated N-player Stag Hunt under programmatic action inversion; honest agents’ Stag choices track public history, but the sharp success drop is **mostly mechanical**: 78% pre-flip vs 12% public success at N=5/M=3/80% corruption, so **original choice / public action / executed outcome must be three separate measurements**; three threshold benchmarks match LLM action rates), and the **$400 real-world game-playing platform** 2607.10309 (Sydney/Oxford/UWA — hardware-emulated keyboard + vision; **1160% degradation** simulation→real, real-world DQN reaches **~49% of human** after 10M steps; the gap is dominated by **perception/actuation interface**, not dynamics). **Cross-cutting**: (1) **decision-time latency is now a measured, reported game-AI metric** — 11.4 µs and 1160% interface degradation in the same digest is the sharpest available statement of why a µs controller ships and a simulator policy does not; (2) **myopia, not capability, is the shared failure, and tools do not fix it** — the LLM in Code to Control discovers ball-velocity extrapolation and time-to-impact threat detection because it is *shown trajectories*; LongPuzzleBench agents with rules + state hints + failure memory all supplied still fail, and code execution does not help; (3) **world-model supply economics changed**; (4) **three independent simulation-vs-rendering decoupling arguments converge** (GameDirector 2609.25652, Programmable World Model, WorldMind, plus the roadmap survey — the renderer is a commodity pretrained video model and the defensible contribution is the explicit-state layer above it); (5) **measurement discipline is the recurring self-correction** — corrupted-communication 78-vs-12, rule acquisition-vs-execution 97.8-vs-3.2, latent-concept salience-vs-interaction — mirroring the 09-30 finding that player-experience metrics are confounded by capability disclosure: *an aggregate number that mixes two mechanisms is not a result*; (6) the PCG close is an engineering paper and that is itself the finding, extending the 09-30 ProcGen random-floor note into level design. **⚠️ Affiliation discipline**: arXiv exposes no affiliation data via API (and the API returned 429 this run). **14 verified** from HTML author blocks (2609.38733, 2609.38428, 2609.36225, 2609.34769, 2609.32208, 2609.36473, 2609.27312, 2609.32048, 2609.31704, 2609.34459, 2607.10309, 2606.18180, 2603.00825, 2511.08585); **1 tentative** with the evidence named (2606.03857, venue + DOI from the listing page only); **3 unavailable** — 2608.23435 (author block has none), 2511.20714 (team name only), 2606.17800 (team name only). Nothing inferred from author surnames. **⚠️ Vacancies that remain**: no peer-reviewed DOI-bearing **player-facing** game-RL deployment; **no self-play / population-based training** paper; **no offline-RL-for-games**; **no hierarchical-RL-for-games**. All four were queried and are recorded as vacancies rather than filled with adjacent robotics or generic-MARL papers. **⚠️ Dropped on dedup**: 2608.14977 (Watermarked Game Solving — **claimed since 2026-08-23**; screened, hit confirmed, dropped), plus 2609.39564 / 2609.31076 / 2609.30177 / 2609.25652 / 2609.22177 / 2606.20210 / 2601.04575 cross-referenced not re-summarized. **⚠️ Method caveat**: compound arXiv queries above ~6 terms return empty, so this run has **no query log comparable to the 09-30 digest**; the §7 vacancy claims rest on fewer queries and should be weighted accordingly. **4 of 18 carry a venue** (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026, REALM @ EMNLP 2026, SBGAMES 2025 + DOI, one IEEE-formatted submission). **No result independently replicated.** 2026-10-01 | arxiv, game-rl, game-ai, llm-agents, game-foundation-models, world-models, pcg, benchmarks, marl, exploration, self-play, imperfect-information, program-synthesis, esports, industry-game-ai, roblox, tencent, latency, sim-to-real, measurement-validity, daily-digest |

**Modular Discovery of General Game-Playing Algorithms** (**all four authors Google DeepMind**) — LLMs as a proposal engine over *algorithmic design space*, co-evolving **game-agnostic C++ search mechanisms** across **400+ environments** against 15 MCTS baselines via AlphaRank + SCO, top-tier and generalizing to unseen games (2609.33115) = the most institutionally significant paper here; **GraphHCA** eliminates hindsight-distribution estimation via a discounted recursion on the induced transition graph with a unique fixed point, ALFWorld **+24.6pp over GRPO**, Sokoban with a VLM agent (2609.35084); RSD-Poker's **learned-then-frozen partition before calibration** is a reusable certification protocol but the numbers are weak-response proxies on a 24-state audit, not win rates (2609.33669); Ensemble-Determinization MCTS with dynamic determinization count + dynamic simulation allocation on Jaipur/Lost Cities/Splendor (UWrów/Maastricht, 2607.13007); **Searching for Primes** proves a token game's solution *is* integer factorization, then attacks it with AlphaZero (2609.22968). ② **§2 Game AI bots (5)** — **GameBoyWorlds** (USC ISI ×5/Columbia/UChicago/Purdue/Georgia Tech) is **the strongest negative result in the digest**: no demos/docs/rewards, frontier models **<50% of 500 tasks**; world modelling and skill discovery **fail**; curiosity-written guides only partly work; a pipeline with multimodal memory + hierarchical subgoals **misses the first major milestone in both fan-made Pokémon games** — and the **Pokémon-Red pre-exposure control** cleanly separates "knows the game" from "can act in this game" (2609.32093); **GlyphBench** (Mila/UdeM/Vmax) 360+ tasks / 9 game families as 2D Unicode grids, **glyphs > text > pixels** in Craftax, gameplay RL lifts Qwen3.5-4B to **63.48% on Reasoning Gym** (paired CI over Math RL [0.38, 2.02]) (2609.34214); **Porimon** (TU Munich) LSTKAG on Pokémon Battles, 15,000 battles, beats PokéLLMon and rule-based — **authors report their own Long-Term KAG contribution as inconclusive**, so short-term state + external damage API likely carries it (FLLM 2026, 2609.32544); OptiArena (EMNLP 2026 Findings) finds LLMs **improve weak starters far more consistently than competent baselines** across 12 models / 5 games (2609.32227); ⚠️ In-game Toxic Detection claims "AAAI 2023" on a 2026 listing with no verifiable venue record — flagged, not cited as SOTA. ③ **§3 Benchmarks (3)** — **SWE-Game** (SJTU/Zhongguancun/Shenzhen/BUPT/Elbetech) 247 tasks over **41 executable reference Godot games** / 13 categories, five task types including **83 injected-fault repairs** and **Godot→Unity porting**, and the key number is **executable checks 92.59% balanced accuracy vs 78.41% for a video-based VLM judge** — 14 points, meaning every video/VLM-judged game evaluation carries that handicap (2609.33678); **best scores stay below 60/100** on all three construction tasks (Brief-to-Game 50.38) with Opus5 leading all five; AI-Generated Interactive Fiction for Education (N=22, EDULEARN26) finds narrative clarity fine but **story-content coherence weakest and quiz integration the bottleneck** (2608.10818); **Riftbound is Turing Complete** constructs universal Turing machines in a commercial LoL TCG and runs the computation in **one game turn** (2609.33839). ④ **§4 Causal** — **Compiling VGDL into Causal Models** (**IEEE CoG 2026**) compiles the symbolic game spec into Dynamic Structural Causal Models, inverting the usual trace-inference direction to buy **absolute causal fidelity by construction**; the catch is that it needs a machine-readable spec, so it does not reach the LLM-authored 3D games that are the current frontier (2609.05459). ⑤ **§5 Player experience / deployed AI (4)** — **RAI / AlphaStar** (UNSW/CSIRO) is **the most important paper here for anyone shipping game AI**: the control stack is unremarkable (cooldown + content filter) but they held the code constant and varied only **capability disclosure**, and the *same bot* was rated **less fair (3.90→2.62) and more toxic (2.00→2.85) for being known to be strong**, with trust moving in **opposite directions by expertise group** → every player-experience metric in this wiki needs a disclosure control (2608.21398); VLM gameplay commentary gets **9× payload reduction** from 3×3 temporal mosaicking and names **hallucinated game state** as its primary failure — *the same weakness SWE-Game measured at 78.41%* (2608.14016); **Capture the Narrative** (4,000 NPC citizens, 108 teams, **7,068,206 bot posts ≈ 60% of platform content**) finds rewarding engagement made teams **spam volume over nuanced influence** and that students did **not** get better at spotting bots — inoculation theory refuted (2607.23993); Hypergamification drives *game structure* from LMS content, bidirectionally (2607.29300). ⑥ **§6 PCG = documented vacancy, not padded** — 10 dedicated queries → 75 unclaimed since 2026-06 → **all 75 false positives** (code generation / scene generation / power-grid topology); cause is that the **09-29 retrospective already harvested 113 PCG papers from 2025-09 onward**; ⚠️ standing note: two queries were **page-capped at 200/102**, so the pool is *not* exhaustively searched and a `max_results=1000` pass is needed before asserting PCG is empty. ⑦ **§7 Related techniques (7)** — **GraphHCA + CRBC (4 shared authors) + HyperMCTS independently converge on one diagnosis: trajectory data is under-exploited.** CRBC gets a Bellman fixed point via **one linear solve** with a finite-depth family recovering visit-local averaging at depth 0 (**+5.59pp ALFWorld**, Qwen2.5-1.5B); HyperMCTS adds a cross-trajectory hypergraph so outcomes under one prefix inform another, and reports **Qwen3.6-27B > Claude Opus 4.6 (max) on Shopping Planning** — to be read as search-compute-equivalent, not model capability (2609.35082, 2609.33920); **What Does a ProcGen Generalization Gap Measure? ⭐⭐ the most useful methodological paper here — it audits other people's published numbers**: a generalization gap without a measured **random floor** is uninterpretable; **sampled-vs-greedy test-time action is silently uncontrolled in 9 of 11 audited codebases**; **35–65% of policy entropy is spent on actions with identical effects**, so raw entropy is a bad convergence diagnostic; in **miner, sampled scores 4.9× the floor while argmax scores below it** — and the author then applies these checks to his own result and **downgrades his own significance claim** (2609.32532), a protocol change the ProcGen/Atari literature should adopt; **TopoExplore** uses persistent homology to find *holes* in the visitation archive as Go-Explore **plus one additive term** (167 vs 152 worlds on TopoGym; **6/8 chambers across 5 seeds vs 1 and 2 of 5** for Go-Explore) (2607.09971); **knowing the demand curve is not the same as predicting the next draw**; 4 falsification conditions stated up front (quality ranking / singleton near-optimal set / wrong utility estimate / short-horizon explorer); **Rerandomization under Interference** 2609.33730: no-harm-preserving covariate use that is **agnostic to interference structure**, and the rerandomization covariates **may depend on treatment assignment** (treated-neighbour fraction) — a design-stage mechanism the field does not currently use; **Bridge-Anchored** 2609.36132: **the center of the honest answer is first-order invariant to the unidentifiable part; only the width moves** — bounds only the bridge-orthogonal residual rather than the whole drift channel, doubly robust conditional on bridge-identified drift, rate-robust Imbens-Manski inference; 质量上界受其所拟合分布的质量约束）—— 目前仅 A.X K2 写清这条因果链。② **固定 k 预算正取代固定窗口成为长上下文注意力的新参数化方式**，使成本曲线从"随长度上升"被改写为"随长度持平"，A.X K2 给了唯一一份带吞吐对照的结构性论证。③ **scaling：A.X K2 是唯一给出政府资助编号 + 固定算力预算 + 消融的基座报告**，使"固定预算下用更少 token Sentinel-1B 丢失 pass 方向的地区收缩 → 年度层差异尚未被验证可用于跨时间比较**）/ **Cosine Similarity Is Not Evidence 2609.30275**（**可解释性产物在全精度校准、量化部署，用尺度不变统计量认证"存活"却不报噪声底**；**κ=nρ²/d，E[cos]≈(1+4/κ)⁻¹**；Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上 **ρ=33–61 → 两次独立运行仅靠采样就达 0.978–0.994**；已发表的"全精度 vs 量化 refusal 方向 cosine **0.996**"**在不知道 n 的情况下不能读作"保持"**；**INT4 方向发生旋转且偏离超过估计量自身噪声，INT8 未检出移动——不是等价性主张**；判据应取量化模型内部的 split-half null，**因为用全精度 null 等于假设待检验的方差**；尺度不变统计量**无法区分决策变量的平移与衰减而两者需要相反补救**；成本仅一次 forward pass）/ **PALM 2609.30316**（金融回测 look-ahead bias 惯例是每年重训 PIT checkpoint，**本文证明年度预训练不必要**——新 checkpoint 在同一评估窗上并未更好；改为在决策日之前的文本上拟合**低秩 adapter、不改动任何预训练权重**，**小 adapter 足以加入新时段且优于 continued pretraining**；十年金融新闻，PIT 模型族 cutoff 跨 20 年、规模 1.3–4.2B）/ **SDT 2609.30299**（PINN **表征课程**：浅层 prefix 在临时 physics-informed head 下训练 → 丢弃 head、冻结 restart 或浅层 warm-start 单独解释**）/ **R-iKFAD 2609.30342**（摩擦张量 O(mn) → **秩-1 外积分解 O(m+n)**，总优化器状态约减半，GPT2-Nano/TinyViT/DistilBERT/GPT2-S **性能持平或更优**；连续时间：γ>0 **SPSD** MuZero-like board-game self-play → LLM reasoning traces (Qwen3-4B six-benchmark mean 24.1→36.6, held-out-game win rate 15%→45%, 2609.30936); **MA-WAM / G2MAF** test-time planning for multi-agent flow policies (2609.31281 / 2609.31286).* **① Game theory (1)**: **Too Late to Slash** — rational validators soliciting an equivocation attack form an **ex post Nash equilibrium** with **zero risk for any gain ε>0**, so algorithmic slashing does not guarantee economic security proportional to bonded stake; the structural cause is that the enforcer *is* the adversary's consensus process (2609.30509). **② Behavior as a specified artifact (4)**: **HuGo** — LLM writes executable closed-loop high-level policy code over a frozen low-level humanoid policy and refines it from rollouts (numerical trajectories + video frames); 5 sim tasks × 2 low-level policies beats a high-level RL baseline, approaches demonstration-based, **zero-shot sim→hardware**, and the *same* refinement loop further improves real-world transfer (2609.30594). **TalkMesh** — GRPO-trained talk policy over a confidence-head-scored mesh of SLMs: 3 agents match majority voting over 32 samples/model; 0.568→0.705 (Qwen3.5-0.8B GSM8K), 0.492→0.722 (SmolLM3-3B MATH-500); **4-of-8 collusion with fabricated confidence → 0.000**, defended rescore recovers 0.507 (2609.30578). **Containing Behavioral Cascades** — one accepted false claim multiplies into fleet-wide replanning; Verify-Adapt-Hold triage makes verification a *team-level planning* problem, not a binary trust call (2609.30523). **ADF-EA** — planner and runtime share one **Device Capability Contract** (invocation conditions, intended effects, evidence, recovery rules) with persistent execution state, formalizing **conditional soundness** and cutting **false completion** (2609.30691). **③ World models / steerable behavior (3)**: **NavGen** — text-to-video generative data engine, **~400K VLN episodes**, model improves with scale and reaches **75%** success deployed in a **world-action-model** paradigm on real flights (2609.30770). **StarWM** (NeurIPS 2026) — reconstruction-based world models **misallocate capacity by pixel area rather than dynamics relevance**; a self-supervised cross-attention module decides *where* reconstruction applies, with stop-gradient barriers, and mechanistic probing confirms state attributes survive long-horizon imagination while distractors are discarded (2609.30667). **SoGuDiff** — diffusion navigation with **continuous composable social-style axes** (passing distance / yield side / deference) tunable at deployment behind a feasibility projection layer, dominating fixed-behavior baselines (2609.30560). **④ PCG (0 — 4th consecutive window)**: a sweep for level generation / PCG / procedural design / dungeon / roguelike over all **915 unclaimed** fresh-window papers returns **zero hits of any kind**. **⑤ Monitoring & evaluation (3)**: **RoboMonitor** — 25 h of policy-learning data across 12 tasks / 2 embodiments pre-trained for monitoring with no monitoring labels; **52 labeled episodes → 93.1% phase accuracy / 85.9% macro recall**, beating Qwen3-VL and Robometer given the *same* supervision and also beating Qwen3-VL given **100** episodes; Temporal SFT cuts spurious phase switching **15.23% → 4.95%**; closed loop 39/40 sim + 35/40 real with no false recovery triggers (2609.30715). **Adaptive XR across the Reality-Virtuality Continuum** — fixed modality measurably affects HRI and **switching mid-task wins**: AR gives significantly lower mental demand/effort/frustration than AV and VR, dynamic RVC gives highest throughput and lowest workload, so the heaviest modality is not the best default (2609.31138). **Steering vs Teleporting in Mobile VR** (VRST 2026) — **gaze suits teleportation, controller pointing suits steering** in primed search; pitch-based speed control recovers continuous head-decoupled locomotion on low-cost narrow-FOV hardware (2609.30620). **⑥ Deployment economics (3)**: **Precision at Speed** — online MBRL with a **precision-gated contouring** objective learns directly on an 11.5-ton hydraulic excavator with no demos and no sim pretraining: **20 min of interaction ≈ 100–150 min** of prior-controller training, sub-cm mean path error at high speed after 40 min (2609.31025). **PP-ProPS** — client-side secret transforms keep policy parameters and rewards confidential from cloud LLM APIs, and the privacy fix is *also* the search fix (component-wise rewards + bounded history): beats Vanilla ProPS on **7/10** tasks and PPO/SAC/TRPO on **5/6** (2609.30554). **OpenHail** — open Gymnasium env for joint EV-fleet control whose configurable **decision-epoch** mechanism supports event-driven / periodic / hybrid / policy-requested control in one operational model, with a fixed-size interface over assign / reposition / charge (2609.30628). **⑦ Provable / rare-event RL (4)**: **QTPT** (NeurIPS 2026) — replacing behavior cloning with a **Bellman-style Q-target** objective makes in-context RL robust to weak/suboptimal offline data, because imitation otherwise bakes sub-optimality in as a *target*; theory in stochastic linear bandits + finite-horizon MDPs, and it honestly reports **value overestimation on unsupported actions** (2609.30391). **Chance-Constrained MDPs with Bellman Distributional Certificates** (NeurIPS 2026) — expected-cost safety fails to bound rare high-cost trajectories; a violation-probability Bellman recursion built **before policy selection and reused across candidates** yields matching upper/lower bounds up to log factors (2609.30856). **Non-linguistic code for inferred rules** — success on new rules tracks **how much a message says about the rule, not how varied messages are**, and it is the **listener's** error gradient that partitions the code while reward alone collapses the speaker to one message (2609.31192). **Agile gap traversal** — quasi-analytical policy gradients avoid backpropagating through visual rendering, and **no reference-trajectory resets are needed**; the expert actor survives platform changes (2609.30696). **Part II — Fri-25 remainder (42 featured + 9 runner-ups).** *Zero direct game-RL environment papers; the game line runs through driving/robotics behavioral modeling, plus a strong real-time-inference block and a negative-result block.* Highlights: swarm **temperament engineering** (§1.2) and an RL-trained pedestrian model validated against four named empirical human behaviors (§2.7) plus a hand-authored finite-state evasive-then-brake driver (§2.8) = **three formalizations of designing a believable-behavior distribution**; **Streaming-WAM** names the **asynchronous-planning consistency bug** (committed-action prefix as first-class conditioning, 98.35% at 2.93× faster) and **latent surrogate solvers** show **compression quality is not rollout quality** (~40% long-rollout error cut at 100× fewer FLOPs with *worse* reconstruction) → one thesis: *train and defend world models for what they imagine, not for what they predict*; **constraint-guided diffusion** takes usable-artifact rate **13.7% → 96.8%** by injecting validity as soft masks during denoising plus a repair projection, which is the whole PCG argument in one measurement; **feasibility collapse** — a safety-constrained policy with the goal inside the constrained region learns to *never arrive* while the compliance metric looks excellent; a **published bandit-PAC lower bound shown incorrect** with two proof gaps located. **Cross-window themes**: adaptation has three loci (policy library / harness / command) and **none of them touch the weights**; safety work converges on *probability-level* rather than *expectation-level* guarantees; evaluation is fracturing into more axes with **recovery** as the newest; deployment numbers are now the most reliable content and two cut against their own headlines. **PCG is 4 windows empty and the cause is now identifiable, not speculative.** | 2026-09-28 | game-rl, game-ai, llm-agents, marl, foundation-models, world-models, world-action-models, nethack, self-play, pcg, benchmarks, industry-game-ai, execution-assurance, false-completion, real-time-inference, game-theory, daily-digest |

Both agree on every shared paper; division is by **selection lens** (broad daily-check vs topic-screened rec/ads/LLM/agents/games). **Process lesson logged in-page: the 09-28 arxiv jobs are not serialized — they need a claim registry or a deterministic claim order.** ① **Recommendation / Advertising / E-commerce (8) — the ~14-window rec drought ends, industrially:** **KuaFu** (2609.31045, Tencent *confirmed*) — item-level behavior compression to **2–4 tokens/item**, **GMV +1.37% over 10 months in production**, **190 GPUs saved**, **4B beats its own 8B**; **RecToolBench** (2609.30717, EMNLP 2026) — headline negative **valid tool calls ≠ successful recommendations**; **SPADE** (2609.31164) user-specific serendipity **Pareto frontier**; **Component Benchmark** (2609.30656, Meta *tentative*) submodule-level profiling for TB-scale rec models; **AgentRecommender** (2609.31166) user-side rec via LLM-agent investigation, **no extra data**; **ZooWork-ShopRanker** (2609.31002) multi-family judge panel manufactures e-commerce's missing pairwise labels. ② **On-Policy Distillation (7 — densest cluster, a consolidation wave):** **Recursive Self-Improvement** (2609.30652) DCE+SRCL **+35.62 pp over OPSD** — names the *teacher freeze buys stability at the cost of teacher staleness* tension; **TISD** (2609.30878) teacher disagreement as **branch proposal**; **MOPD-Router/ExpertAlign** (2609.30837) **token-level teacher routing without domain labels** (+7.8% on *labeled* data while ignoring labels); **Persistent Negatives** (2609.30864) negative distribution as a first-class design axis; **SPSD** (2609.30936) MuZero self-play → superhuman CoT, math **24.1→36.6 with zero human labels**; **EoupCT** (2609.30935) estimates *unknown* pre-training gradients via forgetting-susceptible pseudo-data; **WeEnv** (2609.30766, WeChat *confirmed*) measures the **environment tax at up to 53.4% of agentic-RL iteration time**, cuts it to 9.1% (5.6–14.2× faster init). ③ **Agent Security & Memory (6) — all four authorization papers converge on "no LLM in the decision path":** **AgentXploit** (2609.31318) **59.3% vs Codex 38.4%** exploit rate; **MetaPermit** (2609.31039) **LLM infers meta-attributes, a fixed policy decides**, +109% task completion; **AGATE** (2609.30830) deterministic capability grants, **63/63 replay agreement**; **EffectMatch** (2609.31301) validates the *persistent result*, not the approved action — the missing half of 09-25's LIMBO finding; **Stale-Document Poisoning** (2609.31342) a **non-adversarial** RAG channel where the attacker is *time* — stale evidence flips **30%/37%** of answers with *no* trust instruction, **66%/75%** *with* one; **The Crowd in the Machine** (2609.31060) the 2026 agent incidents via crisis informatics. ④ **Inference, KV-Cache & Serving (5):** **The KV Cache Is the New Memory Wall** (2609.30854) SoK deriving hardware-specific **crossover lengths** where KV traffic overtakes weight traffic, and the **lossless-but-capacity-addressed** vs **lossy-but-bandwidth-cutting** split; **Beyond Mean Attention** (2609.30738) eviction-as-diversity, **mid-layer sign flip worth +13.2** with no re-tuning; **CacheReforge** (2609.30884) **layerwise mixed-version** KV, **−92.4% KL** recomputing only **5.44% of layers**; **DynBranch** (2609.31047) names the agentic blocker — **the cache key is unknowable until the branch resolves** — **−32% latency**; **G²PTQ** (2609.31009) per-block gradient/Hessian refresh + trust-region scaling. ⑤ **Time Series / Forecasting / Sequential Modeling (6):** **EXAONE Demand 1.0** (2609.30880) names **stock-out censoring** as a *bias, not noise*, 11.3M series / 48.4B obs, **beats 36 TSFMs on 22 held-out datasets**; **Aurora-X** (2609.31038) **test-time scaling via variable resolution**; **WorldTS** (2609.31162) covariates into **latent state formation**, not the decoder; **STFO** (2609.31325) *"sensor expansion changes the evidence, not the dynamics"* → **zero sensor-specific parameters**; **EPOC** (2609.30929) **shared endpoint** → −15.40% MSE at **6,352 B** vs ELF's −19.29% at **474,048 B (×75)**; **When 10,000 Windows Are Not 10,000 Tests** (2609.30721) — **additional predictions are not additional independent evidence** (16.9% Type-I error at 75% overlap) — and it **overturns a HARTH conclusion**. ⑥ **World Models / VLA (4):** **Kintsugi-VLA** (2609.31048) turns *discarded* failures into recovery data via **interventional recoverability** with a **non-monotonic** terminal frontier, cost stated (76.8→74.7%); **Fast Plans, Faithful Actions** (2609.30833) negative result as contribution — **57 VLM passes yet erasing waypoint endpoints barely affects success** → **57→8**, LIBERO-Long 91.0→96.2%; **VLaRL** (2609.30868) uses the VLA's **own latent space** as the sim-to-real interface; **OneWorld** (2609.30946) cross-intervention consistency as a *training objective*. ⑦ **Evaluation / Judges / Calibration (4):** **DIAL** (2609.31215) position effects are **judge-specific** so global debiasing is misspecified by construction, releases **410K judgments / 21 judges**; **BAER** (2609.30751) **candidate symmetry as a hard architectural constraint**, wins **8/8**; **Same Text, Different Numbers** (2609.31013) cross-model rank correlation of just **0.52**, disagreement **does not predict** real analyst disagreement → LLM measures are **model-contingent instruments**; **LAVOIR** (2609.30706) **amortized value-of-information in one forward pass** (AUC 0.799 vs 0.797 oracle, 31 ms). ⑧ **Games / RL / Market Mechanics (4):** **CodeHack** (2609.31076, NetHack) skills **triple** progression, **cut cost 86%**, make RL **7.2× faster**; **MA-WAM** (2609.31281) **first test-time world-model planner for multi-agent flow policies** — naive per-agent rollout *structurally cannot* represent simultaneous actions, +22.0%; **Agentic Limit Order Books** (2609.31260) proposes a **three-regime replacement for the square-root market-impact law**; **The Price of Thought** (2609.30705) reasoning effort as an *economic intervention* over **800k+ predictions**: **no reliable net-return gain in any of three families** — a caution on single-run reasoning-budget ablations. ⑨ **Theory / Interpretability (3):** **Effective depth** (2609.31098) closed-form reference **F_L=2L/(L+1)**, **15/16 models below it**, then *disconfirms* the easy explanation; **FTB Graph** (2609.30954) **84.7% Jaccard** base/instruct circuit overlap, warns **EAP scores correlate only weakly with exact patching deltas in FP16**; **LocUS** (2609.31122) steers via the **unembedding matrix**, **<6% of parameters**. **Cross-cutting:** rec is no longer dry but **ads ranking still is** — **no end-to-end CTR-prediction or ad-auction paper in this window**; **"no LLM in the decision path"** is now convergent across MetaPermit/AGATE/EffectMatch; **Jev/Laya is a three-paper line** (PixelJev 09-25 + JevAdvBench + LAVOIR here) → **candidate for promotion to a `wiki/methods/` page**; unusually high methodological honesty (**5 named negative results**, stated costs in nearly every entry). |
