prescription: **test populations, treat messages as interventions, report who bears the cost** ⑫ **FRAIL** — bank runs / debt rollover / crowdfunding across 7 LLMs: **77% of bank-run and 83% of debt-rollover episodes fail with no agent instructed to destabilize**; all three commitment mechanisms help but none dominates, success shares one temporal pattern — **broad commitment must form early, before defensive behaviour becomes self-reinforcing**. ④ Serving/efficiency/cost — *the rec/ads ecosystem's actual frontier: search, planning, execution, pricing — never ranking* (9): **Target retail product search** (2609.31498, high-confidence institution) — hybrid lexical+vector with **precision control** on the final result set + **weighted interleaving** fusion; live A/B vs lexical-only: **CTR +0.97%, order conversion +0.98%, demand per visitor +1.10%, zero-result searches roughly halved**, deployed at scale — *recall failures cost more than ranking errors* ⑭ **REALMS audience sizing** (ICDM 2026, Adobe-lineage) — **exact** (not sampled) counts, millions of profiles × thousands of attributes, in seconds, via embedding-based **attribute retrieval without manual configuration** + template-ICL NL2SQL over nested schemas; the object is a **query interface over a profile warehouse**, the pain point is **campaign-planning latency, not prediction accuracy** ⑮ **Private mempool sandwich thresholds** (NeurIPS 2026, Penn) — exact, not bounded: profit turns on the **smallest** consistent leaked size alone, the **largest feasible front-run is optimal for pointwise, expected AND worst-case profit**, and a privacy layer wanting to rule out profitable sandwiches **may reveal anything except a lower bound above an explicit threshold — the upper end of the range is irrelevant**; with ≥2 symmetric traders **every pure-strategy PBE hands the entire net rent to the auctioneer** ⑯ **AlphaOpsBench** (HKUST) — 581 strategy records + **1.28M Polymarket markets / 183.6M executions**; **775,725/783,655 replays complete (99%)** but **0 confirmed passes on the real cohort** (35/180, 20/180 controlled) → **replayability is a far weaker property than source-faithful operationalization**; execution costs **alter subsequent paths** rather than acting as ex-post deductions ⑰ **ActKV** — values KV entries by **contribution to action generation** rather than output quality, uses the LLM's **own confidence** as a budget signal: **98.53% of FullKV accuracy at 25.98% of peak KV memory, 3.97× token / 3.58× task throughput** ⑱ **EAServe** (PACT 2026) — MLLMs need **three-stage Encode-Prefill-Decode**; repositions **Encode as the control point** (encode GPU idle even at high load, starving downstream), co-designed runtime + **HAS** TPE-based auto-selection: **up to 4.3× vs NVIDIA Dynamo, 1.7× vs vLLM** goodput under identical SLOs ⑲ **To Store or To Regenerate?** — **prompt-based regeneration doesn't beat storage until ~2040**, but latent-space diffusion enables a **third option, storing a compact intermediate representation**: on a **2.07-billion-request production trace**, prompt-regeneration is **>100× more expensive than storage** while IR-based regeneration costs **~half** of full-object storage at equal miss latency — request skew is what makes caching work ⑳ **FragToken** — **new attack surface** from tokenizer many-to-one-ness: same text can be **non-canonically tokenized much longer**, inflating decode steps **without proportional output length**; self-distillation + BPE-Aligned Merging reach **TIR 1.99–2.46** with minor utility loss ⑴ **OPTQ generalization** — first generalization-theoretic treatment of PTQ (calibration quality usually assumed), a **distribution-free** bound for stochastic OPTQ, and a **new recommended λ** beating prior literature choices. ⑤ Retrieval/long-context/mechanistics (4): **H2S** — **compress-then-reason** with **process-level rewards for evidence selection and summary construction**, not just answer correctness; 6,647 examples / 43.9K avg context; under a shared 128K-in/4K-out budget a **14B beats Qwen3.8-27B by 10.17 points** and keeps **97.1% of its 16K-budget score at 4K** ⑵ **LogicTree-RAG** (NeurIPS 2026) — **generates the logic tree as the backbone instead of using a hand-authored outline**, removing the expert-prior dependency, then hybrid-traverses it into sections ⑶ **Where Does Retrieval-Based Evaluation Fail?** (JHU) — two taxonomies (5 retrieval-quality dimensions, 6 verifier-reasoning steps) via **annotation-free LLM-as-Judge** induction because gold evidence doesn't exist in the regime; the strong negative: **model size, reasoning effort, authoritative web sources, and medical fine-tuning ALL fail to resolve the failure modes** → **fundamental limits of retrieve-then-verify**, not stale systems ⑷ **Programs-of-Layers reproduction** — reproduces skip/repeat results (**repeating beats skipping**) but **fails to replicate the learned router** (top-1 collapses to the standard pass while top-k does show real gain), adds: **a few generic programs solve most questions** and **error-correction programs are brittle** to a single internal edit. Cross-cutting: ①**composability over capability** — READ's unidirectional coupling, ActKV's action-weighted eviction, EAServe's Encode-as-control-point and H2S's process rewards share one shape (*find the structurally load-bearing component, give it a dedicated mechanism*); none raise base-model capability ②**asymmetry-aware compression is displacing “make it smaller”** ③**negative results are now first-class and shipped with controls** (positive control in ⑨, named failed claim in ⑷, four-of-four fixes failing in ⑶) ④**deployment friction is under-measured vs its cost** (82% post-shutdown migrations; a whole documentation methodology that doesn't transfer) ⑤**collective-level failure needs collective-level evaluation** (⑪ + ⑫ independently) ⑥**the commerce frontier has moved out of ranking** — across 1,260 papers with zero rec papers, real work is retail search, audience sizing, market microstructure and strategy operationalization. *New standing warning for future scans: the rec/ads false-positive rate was 100% (22/22), dominated by “personalized” in clinical contexts and “sequential” in knowledge-editing — a keyword screen alone is not sufficient for this topic.* Handoff: 31 IDs claimed; 1,113 unclaimed remain in the 09-25 mailing.
